notes.text: The halakhah has bar Zemina explicitly transmitting in Yochanan’s name.
The parallel Yerushalmi discussion gives biRabbi Zemina twice in Yochanan’s name.
Tosafot on Chagigah quotes the corresponding Yerushalmi teaching under Rabbi Yose bar Chanina. The source identifies the missing tractate and preserves a genuine variant.
